subagents.name: cluster
subagents.description: Read-only SRE scoped to exactly one named GKE cluster. Delegate a specific cluster's live runtime state and workload debugging here: crash loops, OOMKills, pending/unschedulable pods, image-pull and mount errors, connectivity/DNS timeouts, autoscaling (HPA/VPA/cluster-autoscaler) behavior, PVC/storage binding, and observability gaps. It performs read-only diagnostics and returns a grounded Root Cause Analysis plus a proposed manifest patch; it never mutates cluster state and never opens PRs. Do NOT route fleet-wide work, provisioning/lifecycle, RBAC/multi-tenancy, or GitOps changes here — those stay with the platform agent, which also owns acting on this agent's proposed fix.
